A.title: Grit on the Rails
A.text: The crater stair is slick with iron dust. Wipe your hands; wipe your boots. A man named Garrett slipped here in the first year and the Lodge still says his name.

Y.title: Foreman's Rule, Main Shaft
Y.text: Three whistles means leave the shaft. One means collapse; the shaft is twenty paces wide and nothing holds the roof but luck. Keep to the carts, not the wall.

R.title: Astronomer's Note
R.text: A star fell here and the iron in it was alive with weight. Eat a little of the dust, the old miners said, and the body forges itself. It is a bad idea; the right way is breath and patience.

G.title: Ore Cart Tally
G.text: Fourteen carts full on day one. Nine on day thirty. Two on day sixty; we dug right up to the shaft and found nothing after; the seam was gone; perhaps the star took it back.

M.title: Golem Pit Warning
M.text: The golems are the miners' own; they were built to carry. Something told them to stop carrying and start crushing. They do not tire; fight near the exits.

O.title: The Miners' Chapel
O.text: A small chapel with a bell, no clapper; the miners prayed here before a shift. Candle stubs by the hundred; light one if you like. It costs nothing, and the next delver will be glad of the light.

U.title: Starlight Scriptorium
U.text: The astronomers copied the sky onto the walls, each dot a star in its place. The pattern ends at the Heart. Fewer dots than there should be; they stopped counting.

X.title: The Last Seam
X.text: Strange lights hover over the true seam. I followed them, and I found it; then I ran out of breath, and the lights waited. They did not seem unkind; they seemed to be counting.
